text:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-east-1). Latency + error spike starting 02:03 UTC. Current error rate ~18%. Pager: @oncall. Warroom: https://warroom.redwood/abc123. Notify: infra + oncall.

emma: Ack. I'm oncall — joining warroom. Can someone confirm customer-impacted routes and recent deploys?

sanjay: I just saw deploy for model-proxy rolled 02:00 UTC (canary). Reverting now if needed. Assigning ownership to myself for initial triage.

linda: I'll take status page and customer comms. Drafting short message: "We are investigating increased errors affecting inference in us-east-1. Some requests may return 500. No action required by customers at this time. Updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts?
mike: +1 on draft. For mitigation, I can flip traffic off the new proxy canary:
```bash
kubectl -n inference patch svc model-proxy --patch '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"false"}}}'
```
This will divert to stable. Doing it now.

incident-bot: ACTION: traffic-redirect initiated by mike at 02:08 UTC. Observability: error rate down to 11% after 90s.

emma: Confirming paging noise suppressed. SLO alert still firing but trending down. Sanjay — can you pull logs from the canary pods for 02:00-02:10 UTC?

sanjay: Pulling logs, found stack trace with OOM in model-proxy v2.3.2. Snippet: "java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space" repeated. Marking as likely cause.

tara: For on-call handoff — I'll standby to take next shift in 40m. Emma, do you want to keep as owner until handoff or transfer to infra?

emma: Keep with sanjay for now (root cause triage). Tara, please be ready for a warm-handoff in 30m. Linda, post status page with draft above + note that mitigation underway and we are rolling back canary.

linda: Posted status: https://status.redwood/incident/4860009999 — includes timeline, impacted regions (us-east-1), customer guidance, and contact. Tagged #customers-notify.

mike: Rolling back model-proxy to stable v2.3.1 cluster-wide. Patch applied at 02:15 UTC. Monitoring CPU/mem.

incident-bot: UPDATE: rollback completed at 02:18 UTC. Error rate now ~2%, still watching.

emma: Great. Sanjay, please collect RCA artifacts (pod logs, heap dumps) and create postmortem draft once we confirm root cause. Include isolation steps for future canaries (resource limits, memory tests).

sanjay: Will do. Capturing heap dump and attaching to warroom. Also opening a short runbook item: always run canary with memory limit 1.5GB for proxy.

tara: Thanks team. I'll take the monitoring & status updates for the next 60m and coordinate customer follow-ups if needed. :thumbsup:

emma: Closing this kickoff thread — moving to warroom for detailed triage. Good job on quick rollback and status comms.
